scenes.conflict: Venn dismisses the humming as a side effect of sedation and will not risk her neural-tissue program or her creature being blamed, while Nadia's best friends are among those who have walked off their posts.
scenes.goal: Nadia wants Venn to acknowledge that the humming workers are infected and to act on it.
scenes.outcome: Venn orders Nadia to log the cases quietly and keep them from Containment. Nadia complies but secretly starts a private record of who is humming.
scenes.summary: In the flooded breeding halls, Nadia reports that several brood workers have abandoned their posts humming in unison. Venn privately recognizes it as the work of her enhanced leviathan and chooses secrecy over alarm.
scenes.title: The First Hum

scenes.conflict: Oyelaran's quota orders demand full output, and Reyes cannot keep production up without the very workers who are beginning to hum and drift.
scenes.goal: Reyes wants to keep his shift intact and his quota met while hiding the first workers who stop answering to their names.
scenes.outcome: Reyes reassigns infected workers to the back filter lines and falsifies the roster, so the symbiont can now reach the ampoule lines and water supply unnoticed.
scenes.summary: On the humid refinery deck, Reyes sees his crew slowing and humming. Remembering the Dividend Dispute leak, he hides the signs rather than report them.
scenes.title: Covering for the Crew

scenes.conflict: Oyelaran wants to keep production running and the creature alive, Brandt demands sealing and destruction, and Venn insists Mother Tithe is a priceless new mind. All three must report on schedule or risk replacement.
scenes.goal: Each head wants to report on the crisis to their shareholder bloc on their own terms and shape the colony's response.
scenes.outcome: A fragile stalemate: no destruction order and no shutdown. Oyelaran quietly claims control of the uplink schedule, and Brandt vows to prepare the Lifeboat Ring anyway.
scenes.summary: The department heads meet under the weeping coral bulkheads of the Spindle. Their funders pull them in opposite directions, and no one will yield.
scenes.title: The Shareholder Clock

scenes.conflict: The capsules and survey submersible hold only about half the crew. Oyelaran invokes shareholder authority, Brandt holds the doors, and Wen is pressed to say whose side her vessel is on.
scenes.goal: Brandt wants to seal the Lifeboat Ring and allocate berths by need, while Oyelaran wants rank-based berths for executives and key assets.
scenes.outcome: Brandt keeps the ring sealed and begins a need-based manifest. Oyelaran vows to undermine her funding, and Wen quietly keeps her submersible's berths off the lists.
scenes.summary: Brandt locks down the docking ring. A standoff over who may leave exposes how few berths exist and how deep the departments' divisions run.
scenes.title: Lockdown at the Ring

scenes.conflict: Infected workers now ring the pen and shield the creature. Bioluminescent pulses make Nadia's humming louder, and Venn's possessiveness collides with Nadia's fear for her friends.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to open a controlled channel of communication with Mother Tithe and learn whether her design caused the contagion.
scenes.outcome: Venn gets a first fragmentary response through the lights and water but also sees her own technicians speaking in unison for Mother Tithe. She realizes her neural enhancements are the likely cause and tells no one.
scenes.summary: Venn and Nadia travel through the sealed corridor to the netted cavern. The Chorus speaks to them through infected workers while Mother Tithe pulses in the dark.
scenes.title: Descent to Mother Tithe

scenes.conflict: Reyes distrusts a Helix technician and fears Brandt will seal the refinery. Nadia fears he is hiding the symbiont's spread through the ampoule lines.
scenes.goal: Nadia wants to find out whether infected workers at the refinery can still act on their own will, and Reyes wants to keep his crew out of quarantine.
scenes.outcome: They agree to share what they know and test one infected worker for a flicker of will. They agree to keep it secret from their department heads.
scenes.summary: Nadia comes to the refinery tracing infected workers who move between the Cisterns and the Refinery. She and Reyes bond over the colleagues they are trying to save.
scenes.title: Shared Secrets

scenes.conflict: Oyelaran demands output despite infected workers on the line. Nadia's test shows infection spreads through ampoules, and any shutdown risks the quarterly dividend and Reyes's own job.
scenes.goal: Reyes wants to get his workers out before the symbiont enters the ampoule lines and shared water, while Oyelaran orders production to continue.
scenes.outcome: Reyes shuts down one ferment line against orders, exposing his hidden infected workers. Oyelaran moves to replace him and sends Brandt's security to seal the deck.
scenes.summary: A spoiled ampoule batch confirms that the symbiont travels through the refinery's own product. Reyes must choose openly between his crew and his boss.
scenes.title: The Chorus Reaches the Refinery

scenes.conflict: Her handwritten ledger lists infected workers as names she still wants to save, but the insurers' mandate and falling oxygen demand that they be treated as lost. Wen refuses to confirm any berths until she knows who is being left behind.
scenes.goal: Brandt wants to finalize the evacuation manifest and decide whether to seal the refinery with infected crew inside.
scenes.outcome: Brandt orders the refinery sealed with a delay she keeps secret, and Wen finally picks a side by holding two submersible berths for the sealed crew.
scenes.summary: At the Lifeboat Ring, Brandt confronts the cost of her rules. Wen tests whether she is a commander or a jailer.
scenes.title: The Ledger and the Sealed Door

scenes.conflict: Venn knows he plans to seize the creature and still needs his access. Brandt accuses both of risking everyone's lives, and the shareholder clock threatens replacement for all three.
scenes.goal: Oyelaran wants to take control of Mother Tithe from Venn and have Brandt's funding cut before the oxygen reserves force a decision.
scenes.outcome: Oyelaran claims authority over the Trench Pen through the uplink and cuts Brandt's resources. Venn, shaken by her own guilt, begins to see that the creature cannot be kept at any price.
scenes.summary: In the Spindle, the three heads clash openly. Oyelaran moves against both rivals while the oxygen counter drops.
scenes.title: A Sold Creature

scenes.conflict: The only vessel capable of reaching the Trench Pen can carry few people, and Wen must decide who rides while the other heads try to block each other.
scenes.goal: Each head wants the survey submersible for their own plan: Venn for a negotiation, Oyelaran for executives, Brandt for evacuees.
scenes.outcome: Wen commits the submersible to a joint mission carrying Venn and Brandt to the Trench Pen, leaving Oyelaran behind and taking responsibility for the choice.
scenes.summary: The standoff at the docks reaches its peak. Wen stops waiting and chooses the plan she judges most humane.
scenes.title: The Run to the Trench

scenes.conflict: The Chorus defends Mother Tithe and presses in on the vessel. Brandt arms the means to destroy the creature while Venn demands a chance to talk, and Nadia feels the pull of the hive's unity.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to negotiate with the Chorus, Brandt wants to end the threat, and Nadia wants to reach the individuals inside the Chorus.
scenes.outcome: Nadia reaches a worker through humming and shows that will survives. Venn accepts her creature's design is the cause and offers a way to interrupt the symbiont. Brandt holds her fire for the compromise.
scenes.summary: At the netted cavern, the leaders face the creature and the Chorus. A fragile bridge between hive and individuals opens.
scenes.title: Mother Tithe

scenes.conflict: Interrupting the symbiont risks Venn's research and her life, and the infected crew may be harmed. Oxygen reserves are low, and Oyelaran tries to stop them to protect production.
scenes.goal: Venn and Nadia want to interrupt the symbiont in the vats and shared water, and Reyes wants to bring his infected crew with them.
scenes.outcome: The symbiont's hold is broken in the Cisterns, freeing some infected workers, at the cost of Venn's research samples and nearly her life. Mother Tithe goes quiet but is not destroyed.
scenes.summary: Using her knowledge of the symbionts, Venn leads the effort to redirect them, while Nadia and Reyes talk their friends back.
scenes.title: Breaking the Hold

scenes.conflict: His shareholders demand his replacement and Brandt demands the resources. He cannot write off the loss or admit that his override helped cause the collapse.
scenes.goal: Oyelaran must decide whether to hand the crew his control of oxygen and supply budgets or defend his standing.
scenes.outcome: Oyelaran releases the oxygen and supply reserves to the crew, sacrificing his position, and finally admits the safety override's role.
scenes.summary: With the Chorus broken and the oxygen low, Oyelaran's last act shows who he has become.
scenes.title: Oyelaran's Last Ledger

scenes.conflict: The insurers' mandate requires sealing the colony and leaving the infected, but Brandt's ledger lists them as people.
scenes.goal: Brandt wants to launch the evacuation by need and decide the fate of the freed and still infected crew.
scenes.outcome: Brandt breaks her mandate and keeps the infected in a quarantined group aboard the evacuation, with Wen and Reyes at their side.
scenes.summary: At the docks, Brandt accepts a costly compromise and treats the infected as people.
scenes.title: Names on the Ledger

scenes.conflict: Venn must give up possessing her creation, and Nadia must decide whether to trust the Chorus's quiet while it may still be alive.
scenes.goal: Venn and Nadia want to decide what happens to Mother Tithe and to the research.
scenes.outcome: Venn agrees to a monitored containment of Mother Tithe, and Nadia stays to keep the channel open. The colony survives, but the future of the creature and its shareholders is uncertain.
scenes.summary: In the quiet Cisterns, mentor and apprentice face the consequences of their choices. The cost is measured in names, not dividends.
scenes.title: What Remains

logline: When the bio-engineered leviathan Mother Tithe binds Mariana Six's workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads with competing shareholder mandates must choose between saving the dwindling colony and securing the creature, while oxygen runs down and the lifeboats can carry only half the crew.
theme: Who is owed survival when profit, safety and will collide
title: Abyssal Shares
